findings.title: Revelation carried into witness
findings.claim: Al-ghayb carries the unseen domain and al-shahada the witnessed domain; when 32:2’s descent, written book, negated doubt, and worlds meet them, the pair can also be read as a route by which what is hidden becomes inscribed and available to witness.
findings.mechanism: The focus names the hidden and witnessed sides under one knower. The pericope’s preceding book descends from the Lord of the worlds, is described as free of doubt, and gives the transfer a written object and an epistemic condition. In the attributed trace, the worlds function as distinguishing signs; together these contacts make the focus pair describe not only the scope of knowing but a source-to-recipient movement into readable testimony.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see how revelation connects what is beyond sight with a public, readable witness, rather than hearing only two abstract domains.
findings.containment: The focus still says that the knower encompasses unseen and witnessed reality. This adds a contextual route through the book; it does not reduce all unseen reality to scripture or claim that the book exhausts it. The supplied alternative remains live: 32:2 may authenticate the book without reframing the focus pair.

epistemic.reason: Exact Arabic anchors and traced word positions are supplied, but the HFT record is legacy_unbound and explicitly leaves context roots, segmentation, and semantic roles attributed. The transfer is therefore bounded as a contextual inference.

findings.title: Measured governance
findings.claim: The affair administered from sky to earth and returning upward in a measured duration in 32:5 meets the focus demonstrative, so knowing, power, and mercy can be read as operating terms of that governance rather than detached titles.
findings.mechanism: The managing verb governs the affair; the upward return and measure supply a bounded circuit. The focus demonstrative gathers that prior movement under the knower, while the attributed reinforcement role makes power the capacity that sustains the circuit and the mercy facet gives that capacity a protective, beneficent orientation.
findings.reader_payoff: The attributes become active in the reader’s view: they describe how a remote-to-present administration is held, measured, and oriented toward good.
findings.containment: The focus still names the knower, the mighty, and the merciful. The reinforcement contribution stays a capacity attributed to the adjective al-Aziz, not a claim that its form is a separate causative verb. The demonstrative may also resume the creator more broadly across 32:4–5.

epistemic.reason: The 32:5 Arabic anchor and traced word positions are exact in the packet, but the HFT root assignments and semantic roles are legacy_unbound nominations. The connection to the demonstrative is therefore retained with its attribution explicit.

findings.title: From concealed formation to embodied witness
findings.claim: Al-ghayb and al-shahada can remain the unseen and witnessed domains while 32:8–32:9 supplies a developmental passage: selected material is formed, receives breath and spirit, and emerges with sight, making the pair newly legible as concealed formation becoming embodied witness.
findings.mechanism: The focus branches carry hiddenness and manifestation; the supplied context adds extracted fluid, formation, breath, spirit, and eyesight. The HFT trace aligns those stages with the focus pair, while its womb and birth roles give the concealed phase a protected site and the witnessed phase an embodied emergence. These contacts make the pair feel like a movement through development rather than only a static classification.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the unseen/witnessed pair as a threshold from hidden beginnings to a formed, perceiving life.
findings.containment: This does not equate the cosmic domains with gestation. Al-Rahim remains the mercy adjective, and al-shahada remains the witnessed domain; the womb and birth-sign images are attributed root-level resonances, not replacement lexical meanings. The exact context names offspring, fluid, formation, breath, spirit, and faculties, while male-fluid and womb-specific details remain legacy_unbound HFT roles. The context may also simply exemplify creation without recasting the focus pair.

epistemic.reason: The 32:8–32:9 Arabic anchors supply a clear developmental sequence, but the cross-root mappings and several detailed bodily roles come only from a legacy_unbound HFT trace. The finding is retained as a bounded contextual analogy.
